With every reincarnation, your relics, skills, companions, and the choices you make become lasting sources of strength, bringing you one step closer to breaking the gods' hold over the world. Break an enemy's defenses to knock them down and create an opening for a follow-up attack. Sever their limbs to permanently disable their abilities and limit their attacks. Will you take supplies from a dying soldier, or escort them to safety? Will you embrace the gifts of darkness, or resist its temptation? Walk the path of Virtue to earn the respect of allies, or embrace Sin to unlock forbidden powers. 👥 Unique Heroes, Distinct Hero Marks From swordsmen and scholars to thieves and merchants, every hero possesses a unique Hero Mark that shapes how they fight and explore the world. Let your heroes inherit abilities from NPCs or use relics to completely transform how their skills work. Every reincarnation is a new opportunity to experiment with different builds. There are no fixed strategies, only the ones you create. 🌫️ Piece Together a Dark Fantasy World Journey through a world shaped by forgotten history, from ruined villages and towering strongholds to barren deserts and cursed lands. As you interact with NPCs and uncover scattered story fragments, you'll gradually reveal the truth behind the Titans, the Umbra, and the mysterious mark you bear.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Overview

The Severed Gods is a turn-based tactical RPG that blends roguelite progression with height-based tactical combat. Set in a dark fantasy world overrun by colossal Titans, a band of heroes marked by fate must walk an endless path of death and rebirth in their quest to slay the gods. Every defeat is a new beginning. With every reincarnation, your relics, skills, companions, and the choices you make become lasting sources of strength, bringing you one step closer to breaking the gods' hold over the world.

Key Features

⚔️ Break, Sever, and Master Height-Based Combat

The battlefield extends beyond a single plane. Every enemy has Low, Mid, and High body parts, each with its own shield and weakness.

Break an enemy's defenses to knock them down and create an opening for a follow-up attack. Sever their limbs to permanently disable their abilities and limit their attacks.

From legs to torso to head, dismantle towering Titans piece by piece until nothing remains.

🔄 Reincarnate, Adapt, Overcome

Death is never the end, it's the beginning of a new cycle.

With each reincarnation, permanently unlock new heroes, upgrade your skills, and carry powerful relics into your next journey.

Every defeat becomes a stepping stone, bringing you closer to the power needed to claim your revenge.

⚖️ Virtue or Sin, Every Choice Matters

Your journey is filled with difficult choices. Will you take supplies from a dying soldier, or escort them to safety?

Will you embrace the gifts of darkness, or resist its temptation?

Every decision shapes your Karma, leading to different consequences and rewards. Walk the path of Virtue to earn the respect of allies, or embrace Sin to unlock forbidden powers.

👥 Unique Heroes, Distinct Hero Marks

From swordsmen and scholars to thieves and merchants, every hero possesses a unique Hero Mark that shapes how they fight and explore the world.

Thieves can steal valuable items from NPCs, Scholars can uncover enemy weaknesses, and Merchants can recruit followers to aid your journey.

Build the right team and combine their unique abilities to survive longer and push further with every reincarnation.

🏛️ Build Your Own Combat Strategy

Experiment with hundreds of skills and relics to create powerful synergies. Let your heroes inherit abilities from NPCs or use relics to completely transform how their skills work.

Every reincarnation is a new opportunity to experiment with different builds. There are no fixed strategies, only the ones you create.

🌫️ Piece Together a Dark Fantasy World

Journey through a world shaped by forgotten history, from ruined villages and towering strongholds to barren deserts and cursed lands.

As you interact with NPCs and uncover scattered story fragments, you'll gradually reveal the truth behind the Titans, the Umbra, and the mysterious mark you bear.
